crossRefs.note: When Pharaoh had let the people go, God didn’t lead them by the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was…
but God led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea; and the children of Israel went up armed out…
Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will go in after them. I will get myself honor over…
Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in…
“I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
